tracker.notes: Slay the Spire includes built-in real-time HUD overlays for multiworld items, relics, and deck progression.

install_instructions: Tier 1 Support: Subscribe to 'ModTheSpire', 'BaseMod', and 'Archipelago Multiworld Randomizer' on the Steam Workshop (ID: 3488453081). Wayfinder automatically populates server credentials into your mod preferences, copies connection info to clipboard, and launches Slay the Spire.
